description: Check EQL syntax and get a cost estimate before anything is activated. Free. Always run this before auto_query_write, and show the estimated cost to the user. tweetAccounts lists the X account behind each tweet condition: billing=per_post accounts cost creditsPerPost for every post from the account (not replies or reposts), matched or not, while the query runs, on top of estimatedCredits, so state that too. Pass either an inline query or a draftId. method=symbol instead checks that a symbol has market data on a venue, before you build price or ta conditions around it.

description.description: Description to validate with the query.

draftId.description: Validate a stored draft instead of an inline query.

method.description: query validates EQL, symbol checks symbol support.

query.description: EQL query object with conditions, actions and expiresIn. Build it with auto_build and check it with auto_validate first. Use notify or webhook actions: a query carrying a credential, such as a telegram_bot botToken or a webhook signingSecret, is refused.
